doc: Packages a staging slot may carry (studio/stage/make-slot.py, tools/check_stage_slot.py). com.gamecore.* packages come from the source project's manifest by absolute file: path to the source repository's Packages/ directory, except the denied ones below (Studio packages never enter a slot; the qualification marker packages compile qualification code in). com.unity.* packages must be listed here by name and carry exactly the source project's pin. The candidate package is embedded under Packages/<name> and is not a manifest dependency.
